prompts.ja: Use case: logo-brand. Original TangoBook handwritten cover-font glyph source sheet. The reference is STYLE ONLY; match ONLY the middle B column: warm, friendly chunky hand lettering, rounded brush terminals, gentle irregularity, readable letter identities. Black ink on pure white. Draw exactly one isolated upright glyph centered in each equal-sized cell, large generous margins, NO grid lines, NO labels, NO decorations. 5 columns by 3 rows, fifteen cells. Row 1: 人 魚 姫 ラ プ . Row 2: ン ツ ェ ル に . Row 3: ん ぎ ょ ひ め . All cells MUST follow this exact Unicode order. Asian writing must be accurate: preserve every stroke and counter; Thai consonants keep correct small loop structures and Thai vowels are separate isolated symbols. Characters remain discrete, do not typeset words. Whole image has the exact stated uniform grid, readable thick but open strokes, suitable for tracing into font outlines. Do not add accent marks to Thai letters. Do not substitute simplified/traditional Chinese forms.
